MESSAGE FROM THE DEAN

A warm welcome to future leaders

Welcome to the Faculty of Computing & Multimedia. In a world driven by technology and innovation, you are now part of a community that empowers minds and shapes futures.

Here, you will be inspired to learn, encouraged to explore, and supported to innovate — together, let's create, transform, and make a meaningful impact in the digital world.

Expertise: AI, machine learning, game-based learning, multimedia technology, dyslexia research & assistive technology.
